tracks.title: Your Ball's on My Side
tracks.subject: a man on a public tennis court whose neighbour on the next court keeps hitting her balls over the net divider every Saturday morning
tracks.caption: Funk-soul R&B in the live-band style of mid-2020s Black American R&B. Live drums with ghost notes on the snare and a loose swung hi-hat; a rubbery fingerstyle bass walking under every bar; a wah-pedal rhythm guitar scratching sixteenths; a Rhodes electric piano playing ninth chords; a short horn section stabbing at the end of each chorus line. Warm live-room recording, dry drums, bass forward, light tape saturation. Male tenor, relaxed and playful in the verses, easing into falsetto and small ad-lib runs in the chorus. 98 BPM, E minor. Flirty, loose and self-amused. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no 808 bass, no EDM synths, no rap verse.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - wah guitar and bass]

[Verse 1]
Court number four, Saturday, nine on the dot
Her serve's got nowhere to go but into my spot
Yellow ball rolls past my shoe, she's waving her racket
I jog it back slower than anyone has to

[Pre-Chorus]
My buddy says, man, we're meant to be playing

[Chorus]
Your ball's on my side again, don't you worry
I'll bring it back over, I'm in no hurry
Hit it as wild as you want, I'll be waiting
Your ball's on my side again, keep it coming

[Verse 2]
Week number six and she's barely even aiming
Lobs it clean over and points at me, blaming
I said, you're a menace, she said, you're slow
Then she asked for a match, said, winner picks where we go

[Pre-Chorus]
My buddy packs his bag and says, I'm out of here

[Chorus]
Your ball's on my side again, come and get it
Bring your own racket, we'll play one set of it
Loser buys coffee, and I plan on losing
Your ball's on my side again, and so are you

[Outro - horns and Rhodes]
Love fifteen, love thirty
Somebody's gotta keep score

tracks.title: The Last Piece
tracks.subject: a man who hides the final piece of his partner's thousand-piece jigsaw in his pocket so they can finish it together on a Sunday night
tracks.caption: UK neo-soul pop in the 2025 London jazz-soul singer-songwriter style. Brushed drums with a soft rim click; a round upright bass; a nylon-string guitar picking light chords; a jazz piano voicing major-seventh and ninth chords; a soft flugelhorn answering the voice between lines. Intimate and natural production, little reverb, audible room tone, piano and voice centred. Female alto, warm and close-miked, phrasing a little behind the beat, light self-harmony in the chorus. 84 BPM, D major. Tender, unhurried and quietly happy. No trap drums, no autotune, no big pop drop, no synth pads, no gospel choir.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - jazz piano and brushed snare]

[Verse 1]
Three weeks of sky on the coffee table
All of it blue and you sorted every shade
Edges done the first night like you always do
You hum when you find one, you don't know you do

[Pre-Chorus]
Nine hundred ninety-nine
And one in my jeans

[Chorus]
Leave the last piece for me
It's a lighthouse window, it's the size of my thumb
Leave the last piece for me
I want to be there when it's done

[Verse 2]
You searched the carpet, you lifted the cat
You swore at the box and the lighthouse on the lid
I came in with tea and I put down a mug
And I pulled out my hand and you knew, and you laughed

[Pre-Chorus]
You said you are the worst
Then you made room on the couch

[Chorus]
Put the last piece in with me
Your hand on my hand, push it in by the frame
Put the last piece in with me
Then tip out the next one again

[Outro - piano and flugelhorn]
Two thousand pieces next time
Leave the corner for me

tracks.title: Second Place Marrow
tracks.mood: raw, rueful and funny at her own expense
tracks.subject: a woman losing the village show's biggest-marrow prize to the same retired man for the third summer running, with her allotment marrow on a wheelbarrow
tracks.caption: UK pop-soul rock in the raw 2025 London confessional style. Loose live drums with a heavy tom fill into each chorus; an upright piano hammered in block chords; a crunchy overdriven electric guitar strumming whole bars; a simple root-note bass guitar. Raw and close production, slight room bleed, the voice very forward and unpolished. Female voice, a raspy chest belt, talk-singing the verses and cracking into a shouted chorus. 76 BPM, F major. Raw, rueful and funny at her own expense. No autotune, no trap beat, no EDM build, no glossy pop polish, no choir.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - overdriven guitar and kick drum]

[Verse 1]
I fed it tea and banana skins all summer
Talked to it nightly like it was my son
Wheeled it to the village hall in a barrow
Twelve kilos of hope under a tea towel

[Pre-Chorus]
And there's Derek at the trestle table
Smiling like he knows

[Chorus]
Second place marrow, second place me
Red rosette for Derek, blue one for me
Three summers running and the judge didn't blink
Second place marrow, I'm going home to drink

[Verse 2]
His is the size of a sleeping Labrador
Mine's more a chubby baby in a pram
He shook my hand and said, love, it's the compost
I said, Derek, tell me, what's in your compost

[Pre-Chorus]
He just tapped his nose
And bought me a scone

[Chorus]
Second place marrow, second place me
Red rosette for Derek, blue one for me
Next year I'm digging up the whole of plot three
Second place marrow, Derek, wait and see

[Outro - guitar feedback]
Banana skins and tea
Banana skins and tea

tracks.title: Four A.M. Proof
tracks.subject: the overnight baker at a supermarket in-store bakery waiting on dough to prove at four in the morning while the shelf-stackers argue about football
tracks.caption: Grunge revival in the 2025 Los Angeles young-band style, loud-quiet-loud. Clean arpeggiated electric guitar in the verses; heavy fuzz drop-D guitars slamming in for the chorus; a distorted bass doubling the riff; pounding live drums with washing crash cymbals. Thick, garage-loud production, wide guitars, vocal slightly buried in the mix. Male baritone, slurred and low in the verses, rising to a hoarse shouted chorus. 118 BPM, D minor. Bleary, sardonic and restless. No nu-metal rap, no screamed metalcore breakdown, no autotune, no electronic drums, no pop-punk brightness.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - detuned guitar and bass, slow]

[Verse 1]
Hairnet, white clogs, the oven clock says four
Two hundred baguettes and nobody wants more
The dough's in the cabinet, it's taking its time
Somebody's stacking beans in aisle nine

[Pre-Chorus]
Can't rush it, can't rush it
It rises when it wants

[Chorus]
Proof, proof, come up for me
I've been awake since yesterday
Proof, proof, the doors open at eight
And I'm the one they'll blame

[Verse 2]
Flour in my eyebrows, flour in my phone
The radio plays one song and leaves me alone
Gary's on the forklift telling everyone
Who should've played striker, who should've run

[Pre-Chorus]
Can't rush it, can't rush it
It's doubled, nearly done

[Chorus]
Proof, proof, come up for me
Slash the tops and in they go
Proof, proof, the doors open at eight
And nobody will know

[Outro - feedback and a slow tom]
Smells like a morning
I'm going home to bed

tracks.title: Minding Your Goldfish
tracks.subject: looking after his crush's goldfish while she is on holiday and reporting its every move by text
tracks.caption: Doo-wop revival in the 2025 Broadway-veteran harmony-group style, uptempo street-corner doo-wop. Four-part male backing harmonies singing doo-wop syllables with a deep bass voice underneath; an upright bass slapping a walking line; brushed shuffle drums; piano pounding triplet chords; a raspy tenor saxophone break. Vintage mono-feel room sound, light spring reverb, harmonies stacked close behind the lead. Male lead tenor, earnest and sweet, falsetto lifts at the ends of phrases. 132 BPM, C major. Bouncy, lovesick and silly. No modern trap drums, no autotune, no synths, no hip-hop beat, no electric guitar distortion.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - bass voice and piano triplets]
Bom bom bom, shoo-be-doo

[Verse 1]
You left me with your goldfish and a pot of flakes
Said a pinch in the morning, that's all it takes
His name is Mister Barry and he's orange and round
I've sent you nineteen photos and he hasn't made a sound

[Chorus]
I'm minding your goldfish, baby, every single day
He swam to the left and then he swam the other way
I tell him all about you and he blows a little bubble
Come home on Friday, baby, he's no trouble

[Verse 2]
I bought him a castle and a plastic little tree
I read him the paper, he looks right at me
Your mother called to check if he's alive and well
I said he misses you, I think, it's kind of hard to tell

[Bridge - sax break]
Shoo-be-doo, Mister Barry, shoo-be-doo-wop

[Chorus]
I'm minding your goldfish, baby, every single day
He swam to the left and I swear he said your name
When you come for Mister Barry, could you stay a little while
Bring him home on Friday, baby, bring that smile

[Outro - harmonies fade]
Bom bom bom, he's doing fine
Bom bom bom, and so am I

tracks.title: Nunggu Nasi Matang
tracks.subject: a couple dancing in their narrow rented kitchen while waiting for the rice cooker to click over to warm
tracks.caption: Indonesian disco revival in the Diskoria style, late-70s Jakarta disco re-cut for today. Live four-on-the-floor drums with an open hi-hat on the off-beats; a round octave-jumping disco bass; a wah-wah rhythm guitar in sixteenths; a string-machine pad swelling into each chorus; a Rhodes comping between lines. Warm tape colour, roomy, bass and kick forward. Male light tenor and female alto duet trading lines, playful and close-miked, unison on the chorus. 118 BPM, D minor. Warm, flirty and domestic. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop, no dangdut kendang, no house piano.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - disco bass and wah guitar]

[Verse 1]
Lampu dapur kedip-kedip, kipas angin muter pelan
Kamu cuci beras sambil nyanyi lagu dari radio
Aku cuma mau ambil gelas, kok tanganku kamu tarik
Dapur dua meter persegi, katamu ini lantai dansa

[Pre-Chorus]
Tombolnya masih merah, sabar dulu, Sayang

[Chorus]
Nunggu nasi matang, kita goyang di depan kompor
Pinggulmu kena wajan, aku pura-pura nggak lihat
Klik dari rice cooker, itu tanda kita berhenti
Tapi masih ada lima menit, sini, satu putaran lagi

[Verse 2]
Tetangga ketok tembok, katanya sendalku berisik
Kamu ketawa sampai sendok sayur jatuh ke lantai
Telur ceplok di wajan pinggirnya mulai gosong
Kamu bilang nggak apa-apa, yang penting iramanya pas

[Pre-Chorus]
Tombolnya sudah kuning, tapi lagunya belum habis

[Chorus]
Nasi sudah matang, kita goyang di depan kompor
Piring belum ditata, kamu masih muter di lenganku
Klik dari rice cooker sudah lewat dari tadi
Biar telurnya dingin, sini, satu putaran lagi

[Outro - strings and Rhodes fade]
Besok kita masak lagi, ya
Aku yang cuci berasnya

tracks.title: Kolong Banjir
tracks.subject: riders pushing stalled motorbikes through a flooded underpass while a politician's smiling billboard hangs above them
tracks.caption: Indonesian heavy alternative rock in the vein of .Feast, riff-driven and political. Two drop-D distorted guitars chugging a stop-start riff; a fuzz bass doubling the low end; hard-hitting live drums with tom fills and crash-heavy choruses; a feedback-laced guitar lead in the bridge. Dense and loud, dry room drums, guitars wide and saturated. Male baritone, half-spoken and sardonic in the verses, shouting a gritty chorus. 132 BPM, D minor. Sardonic, heavy and fed up. No pop-punk bounce, no autotune, no synth pads, no clean ballad breakdown, no screamo.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - drop-D riff and drums]

[Verse 1]
Air setinggi lutut di kolong jembatan
Motor mati semua, busi kena basah
Abang ojol dorong sambil teriak ke HP-nya
Orderan batal, saldo tinggal dua ribu

[Pre-Chorus]
Di atas kepala kami ada baliho
Bapak berpeci senyum dari tahun lalu

[Chorus]
Dorong, dorong, kolong banjir lagi
Janjinya got dikeruk sebelum musim hujan
Dorong, dorong, sepatu sudah pasrah
Bapak di baliho kok nggak ikut kebasahan

[Verse 2]
Ibu-ibu angkat daster sampai ke paha
Bocah main perahu dari kardus mi instan
Ada yang live di TikTok minta like dan doa
Aku cuma mau sampai kantor sebelum jam sembilan

[Pre-Chorus]
Baliho itu robek sedikit di pojok
Tapi senyumnya awet kayak cat tembok

[Chorus]
Dorong, dorong, kolong banjir lagi
Tahun depan ganti baliho, airnya tetap sama
Dorong, dorong, knalpot minum air
Bapak di baliho, sini turun, bantu dorong juga

[Bridge - feedback guitar and toms]
Lima tahun sekali kalian datang
Bawa kaos, bawa nasi, bawa senyum

[Outro - riff stops dead]
Busi dijemur di atas jok
Nanti sore kita dorong lagi

tracks.title: Topping Dobel
tracks.subject: a martabak manis seller in a Bekasi night street stall who argues with every customer that chocolate-cheese-peanut-condensed-milk is too much, then makes it anyway
tracks.caption: Garut hip metal funky in the style of Voice of Baceprot, a power trio fusing metal riffs with hip-hop groove. A slap-and-pop funk bass carrying the verses; a downtuned metal guitar answering with palm-muted riffs and wah-wah fills; hip-hop groove drums with a fat, heavy snare and half-time breakdowns. Punchy live trio sound, bass up front, tight and dry. Female mid-range voice, rapid rap-sung verses, a melodic shouted chorus with girl-gang backing shouts. 98 BPM, E minor. Cheeky, stubborn and bouncing. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no nu-metal screaming, no EDM elements, no pop ballad bridge.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - slap bass, distorted guitar, drum groove]

[Verse 1]
Jam sembilan gerobak udah ngebul
Adonan tebel, mentega sebalok
Mas yang pakai helm minta semua
Cokelat keju kacang susu, sekalian wijen

[Pre-Chorus]
Gue bilang, Mas, itu kebanyakan
Dia bilang, Kak, gue yang makan

[Chorus]
Topping dobel, topping dobel
Martabak lu jadi kayak bantal
Gue protes, lu nggak denger
Ya udah, gue bikin juga

[Verse 2]
Mbak yang kedua minta pandan
Isinya ketan hitam sama Toblerone
Gue diem sebentar, tarik napas
Ini martabak apa eksperimen

[Pre-Chorus]
Gue bilang, Mbak, itu aneh banget
Dia bilang, Kak, coba dulu

[Chorus]
Topping dobel, topping dobel
Gue cicip, kok enak banget
Besok gue tulis di menu
Spesial Mbak yang aneh itu

[Outro - bass and drum break]
Satu lagi, Kak, yang biasa

tracks.title: Minyak Wangi Tanah Abang
tracks.subject: a perfume-oil seller in Tanah Abang market who can mix a bottle to match any smell a customer describes
tracks.caption: Gambus psychedelic rock in the style of Clever Moose, Malay-Arab gambus fused with 70s psych rock. An oud picking fast hijaz-mode riffs; a fuzz electric guitar doubling the oud line an octave down; marwas hand drums clattering in interlocking patterns over driving rock drums; a reverb-soaked combo organ holding drones. Warm 70s fuzz, spring reverb, slightly wobbly tape, percussion forward. Male tenor with nasal, ornamented Malay-Arab melisma, slipping into half-spoken bargaining lines. 112 BPM, E Phrygian dominant. Hypnotic, sly and swaggering. No dangdut koplo kendang, no trap beat, no autotune, no EDM synths, no pop ballad chorus.

tracks.title: Layangan Tujuh Belas
tracks.subject: a kampung kite maker who builds a three-metre kite for the Seventeenth of August contest and the whole street takes turns holding the line in the rice field
tracks.caption: Indonesian orchestral folk-pop waltz in the manner of Sal Priadi, poetic and theatrical. A fingerpicked nylon-string guitar and an upright piano carrying a 3/4 lilt; a string quartet answering each line and swelling into the choruses; a clarinet counter-melody; soft brushed drums keeping the waltz. Warm, close and acoustic, gentle room reverb, strings rising in the final chorus. Male baritone crooner, intimate and conversational, opening up on the last chorus. 84 BPM, G major. Tender, nervous and quietly proud. No trap beat, no autotune, no power-ballad drums, no EDM pads, no dangdut.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - strings in 3/4, acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1]
Seminggu Pak Darto di teras rumah
Bambu diserut, kertas minyak merah putih
Anak-anak duduk, nggak ada yang ngomong
Takut lemnya belum kering

[Pre-Chorus]
Tiga meter, katanya
Paling gede sekecamatan

[Chorus]
Naik, naik, layangan tujuh belas
Di atas sawah, angin lagi pas
Benangnya kita pegang bergantian
Satu gang narik pelan-pelan

[Verse 2]
Pagi itu angin sempat hilang
Layangan nyangkut di pohon kelapa
Bu RT teriak, panjat, panjat
Pak Darto cuma senyum sabar

[Pre-Chorus]
Jam dua belas angin datang
Semua orang lari ke pematang

[Chorus]
Naik, naik, layangan tujuh belas
Merah putih, tinggi dan bebas
Juara dua juga nggak apa-apa
Satu gang pulang ketawa

[Outro - strings settle]
Tahun depan empat meter
Katanya

tracks.title: 帯の結び方
tracks.subject: a boyfriend who secretly learns to tie a yukata obi from videos so he can dress her for the summer fireworks festival
tracks.caption: Japanese UK garage 2-step pop in the late-2020s Tokyo style. A shuffled 2-step drum machine with skipping kicks, rimshots and swung hi-hats; a rounded sub bass sliding between root notes; Rhodes electric piano playing minor-seventh chords on the off-beats; filtered organ stabs at phrase ends; muted clean guitar plucks in the gaps. Late-night and clean, crisp swung hats, warm sub, short room reverb with space between hits. Male voice, a soft close-miked light tenor, half-spoken in the verses with a light double on the chorus. 132 BPM, F minor. Shy, warm and quietly giddy. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no four-on-the-floor house kick, no EDM drop, no rap verse.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - 2-step drums and Rhodes]

[Verse 1]
先週から 夜中にこっそり
動画を止めては 巻き直してた
帯をふた巻き ぐっと締めて
羽根みたいに 結べるはずなんだ

[Pre-Chorus]
「誰に習ったの」って 君が笑う
まあね とだけ 言っておく

[Chorus]
後ろ向いて じっとしてて
ちょっと苦しい? もうちょっとだけ
花火まで あと三十分
君の背中で 答え合わせだ

[Verse 2]
左右の長さが ちょっと違う
やり直したら 時間がない
「これでいいよ」と 鏡を見て
君がくるっと 一回まわった

[Pre-Chorus]
下駄の音が 先に走る
待ってよ 財布 忘れてる

[Chorus]
後ろ向いて じっとしてて
花火の音で 帯が揺れる
ゆがんだ結び目 誰も見てない
君の背中だけ 僕が見てる

[Outro - Rhodes and shaker]
来年は ちゃんと結べるから

tracks.title: ひまわりの種
tracks.mood: bouncy, carefree and a little silly
tracks.subject: hunting for an escaped hamster around a small apartment at midnight with a trail of sunflower seeds and a flashlight
tracks.caption: Japanese house-pop with a classic 90s piano-house backbone. A four-on-the-floor 909 kick with open hi-hats on the off-beat and a clap on two and four; M1-style house piano chords stabbing in a syncopated pattern; a warm finger-style electric bass walking under the chords; short string pad swells into each chorus. Bright and roomy, kick and piano upfront, the pad gently sidechained to the kick, a dry vocal with a short slap delay. Male voice, a relaxed light tenor, talk-singing the verses and opening into a bright unison chorus. 122 BPM, A-flat major. Bouncy, carefree and a little silly. No trap drums, no autotune, no big EDM build or drop, no rap section, no dubstep wobble.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - house piano and four-on-the-floor kick]

[Verse 1]
夜の十二時 ケージが空っぽ
扉がちょっとだけ 開いてる
冷蔵庫の下 本棚のうしろ
懐中電灯で 床をなぞる

[Pre-Chorus]
ひまわりの種 ひとつ ふたつ
台所まで 並べていく

[Chorus]
出ておいで もちまる
怒らないから 出ておいで
種はここだよ ほっぺたいっぱい
出ておいで もちまる

カサッと音が ソファの奥
しゃがんだ瞬間 膝が鳴る
眠れないのか 隣の部屋から
壁をトンって 一回たたかれる

[Pre-Chorus]
すみません 小声で謝って
最後の種を 手のひらに

[Chorus]
出てきたね もちまる
ほっぺたぱんぱん 帰ってきた
手のひらの上で 種を数えて
おかえり もちまる

[Outro - piano alone]

tracks.title: おなか引っこめて
tracks.subject: the morning of the company health check: fasting since nine the night before and holding your breath for the waist measurement
tracks.caption: Japanese brass-driven pop rock in a celebratory arena style. Punchy live rock drums with a big dry snare; a driving eighth-note electric bass; overdriven rhythm guitar chugging power chords; a four-piece horn section of two trumpets, tenor sax and trombone blasting unison riffs, falls and short stabs between vocal lines. Loud and tight, horns bright and upfront, guitars wide. Male voice, a theatrical, shouty high baritone with gang vocals answering in the chorus. 168 BPM, B-flat major. Rowdy, comic and defiant. No trap drums, no autotune, no ska upstroke guitar, no metal breakdown, no synth leads.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - horn riff and drum fill]

[Verse 1]
ゆうべ九時から 何も食べてない
コーヒーもだめ 水だけならいい
受付で渡された紙コップ
同期のやつは もう顔が青い

[Pre-Chorus]
次の方どうぞ メジャーが待ってる

[Chorus]
おなか引っこめて 息を止めて
あと二センチ 神様たのむ
おなか引っこめて 背すじ伸ばせ
去年のおれに 負けてたまるか

[Verse 2]
採血の針から目をそらし
視力はなぜか 去年よりいい
体重計には 靴下も脱いで
ベルトの穴は 見なかったことに

[Pre-Chorus]
はい楽にして 楽にできるか

[Chorus]
おなか引っこめて 息を止めて
看護師さんが 笑いこらえてる
おなか引っこめて もう限界だ
結果は来月 今日は牛丼

[Outro - horn falls and final hit]
大盛りで

tracks.title: 三回目の貸出延長
tracks.subject: renewing the same library novel for the third time without having read past page forty
tracks.caption: Japanese lo-fi jazz hip-hop in the Nujabes lineage. A dusty boom-bap drum loop with a lazy swung snare and soft kick; an upright bass walking in short phrases; muted jazz piano playing ninth-chord voicings; a brushed ride cymbal; a soft flugelhorn answering the vocal between lines. Warm and dusty, vinyl crackle underneath, rolled-off highs, tape saturation, a close dry vocal. Male voice, a murmured low baritone half-rapping the verses and singing a soft hook. 84 BPM, D minor. Drowsy, wry and unhurried. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no 808 bass, no EDM elements, no aggressive rap delivery.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - piano loop and vinyl crackle]

[Verse 1]
カウンターの人 もう覚えてる
この本ですね って先に言われた
しおりは今も 四十ページ
主人公はまだ 駅で待ってる

[Chorus]
三回目の貸出延長
返すつもりは ちゃんとあるんだ
読まないくせに 手放せない
あと二週間 鞄の底で

[Verse 2]
電車で開いて 二行で寝る
風呂で開いて ちょっと濡らした
予約してる人 誰もいなくて
それがなんだか ありがたかった

[Chorus]
三回目の貸出延長
次は無理です って言われた
今夜こそ 駅のその先へ
あと二週間 枕のとなりで

[Outro - flugelhorn and bass]
四十一ページ
やっと電車が来た

tracks.title: ガチャあと一回
tracks.subject: feeding three-hundred-yen coins into a capsule-toy machine for the one missing figure, a cat in a teacup
tracks.caption: Japanese kawaii future bass in the Snail's House netlabel style. Wide supersaw chord stacks pumping with heavy sidechain and pitch wobble; music-box and glockenspiel melodies sparkling on top; a bright square-wave lead answering the voice; punchy half-time drums with big layered claps; a bubbly sub bass. Glossy and sparkly, chords breathing hard with the kick, high-end chimes, compact reverb. Female voice, a bright, bouncy high soprano with clipped syllables and an airy stacked chorus. 150 BPM, E major. Hyper, cute and stubborn. No trap hi-hat rolls, no autotune, no dubstep growl, no rap verse, no rock guitars.

[Intro - music box and supersaw swell]

[Verse 1]
駅ビルの前 カプセルトイ
シークレットは ティーカップの猫
うさぎ くま くま またうさぎ
財布の小銭が どんどん減る

[Pre-Chorus]
両替機まで 走ってくる

[Chorus]
ガチャあと一回 あと一回
ハンドル回すと 胸が鳴る

猫ちゃん出てきて お願いだから

後ろの子どもが じっと見てる

くまもあげるね 喜んでる
わたしの棚は まだ空いたまま

[Pre-Chorus]
最後の三百円 にぎりしめて

[Chorus]
ガチャあと一回 あと一回
カプセルの色が いつもと違う
ガチャあと一回 開けてみたら
ティーカップの猫 こんにちは

[Outro - glockenspiel and claps]

tracks.title: 페이스 맞추기
tracks.genre: atmospheric drum and bass idol pop
tracks.subject: a man in a Han River night running crew who quietly slows from his usual pace every Thursday so he can run beside the newest member
tracks.caption: Atmospheric drum and bass idol pop in the 2024-2025 liquid style. A fast rolling liquid breakbeat with ghost-note snares; a deep warm sub-bass sliding under each chord; an airy evolving pad; a clean electric piano playing soft sevenths; a filtered electric guitar arpeggio in the chorus. Hazy and wide, soft hall reverb, drums crisp but sitting low. Male soft light tenor, breathy and close-miked, half-time phrasing over the fast drums. 172 BPM, F# minor. Tender, nervous and quietly in love. No trap, no autotune, no EDM drop, no rap, no jump-up wobble bass.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - 패드와 브레이크비트]

[Verse 1]
목요일 아홉 시 반포대교 밑
크루 애들은 벌써 저 앞에 가
너는 숨 고르면서 신발끈 묶고
나는 시계를 슬쩍 꺼놔

[Pre-Chorus]
오늘도 나 혼자 좀 늦게 갈게
그냥 다리가 좀 무거워서

[Chorus]
네 숨소리에 발을 맞춰
하나 둘 하나 둘 강바람 따라
기록 같은 건 상관없어
너랑 같은 속도면 돼

[Verse 2]
삼 킬로쯤에서 네가 웃으며
너 원래 빠르잖아 하고 물어
아니라고 했는데 표정에 다 써 있대
가로등 아래서 걸렸어

[Pre-Chorus]
그럼 다음 주엔 내가 맞출게
네가 그렇게 말하고 뛰어가

[Chorus]
네 숨소리에 발을 맞춰
하나 둘 하나 둘 다리 불빛 따라
결승선 같은 건 없어도
너랑 같이 들어가면 돼

[Outro - 패드가 사라지며]
다음 주 목요일 아홉 시 반

tracks.title: 파라솔 만 원
tracks.subject: haggling with the parasol rental man on Haeundae beach who starts at twenty thousand won and ends up bringing watermelon
tracks.caption: Busan surf rock in the style of the city's indie band scene. A twangy Fender guitar drenched in spring reverb playing tremolo-picked lines; driving surf drums with a fast snare shuffle; a round picked bass; a tambourine on every beat; a Farfisa organ swelling under the chorus. Live-room recording, heavy spring reverb, slightly lo-fi, guitars upfront. Female plain alto, deadpan and bright, unison gang vocals on the chorus. 152 BPM, E major. Sunny, scrappy and laughing. No synths, no trap, no autotune, no ballad build, no pop-punk power chords.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - reverb surf guitar and drums]

[Verse 1]
해운대 모래 위 아저씨 한 명
파라솔 하나에 이만 원이래
나는 지갑을 열어 보여 줬지
천 원짜리 열 장, 딱 그것뿐

[Pre-Chorus]
아저씨, 바람 불면 날아가잖아요

[Chorus]
만 원, 만 원, 파라솔 만 원
그늘은 반만 써도 괜찮아
만 원, 만 원, 웃으면서 만 원
파도 소리는 공짜잖아

[Verse 2]
아저씨가 하늘 보며 한숨 쉬더니
알았다, 대신 오래 있지 마라
한 시간 뒤엔 아이스박스 들고 와
수박 한 쪽까지 놓고 가셨어

[Pre-Chorus]
아저씨, 이러면 제가 미안하잖아요

[Chorus]
만 원, 만 원, 파라솔 만 원
수박까지 얹어서 만 원
만 원, 만 원, 내년에도 만 원
그땐 내가 커피 살게요

[Outro - surf guitar and organ]
해 질 때까지 앉아 있을게요
아저씨, 접는 건 도와 드릴게요

tracks.title: 얇은 벽
tracks.subject: a gosiwon tenant whose neighbour practises the same three chords every night through the thin wall, until he hums the melody back and they finish the song together through the wall
tracks.caption: Korean Britpop-style guitar pop in the vein of 2025 Seoul indie bands. A jangly twelve-string electric guitar playing ringing open chords; a crunchy rhythm guitar doubling the chorus; a melodic bass walking between chords; straight roomy rock drums with tambourine on the backbeat; a piano hammering eighth notes in the last chorus. Bright 90s band mix, guitars layered, little reverb. Male mid-range voice, nasal and wry in the verses, open-throated singalong in the chorus. 128 BPM, G major. Wry, warm and slowly won over. No synths, no trap, no autotune, no shoegaze wash, no ballad strings.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - jangly twelve-string guitar]

[Verse 1]
고시원 307호, 벽은 종이 한 장
밤 열두 시면 옆방 기타가 울려
G에서 C, 다시 D로 가다가
꼭 거기서 줄 하나가 틀려

벽을 두 번 두드리려다 말았어

얇은 벽 너머로 너는 치고 나는 들어

얇은 벽 너머로 오늘도 같은 노래
틀려도 괜찮아, 다시 쳐 봐

사흘째 밤에 나도 모르게

얇은 벽 너머로 너는 치고 나는 불러
얼굴도 모르는데 박자는 딱 맞아
얇은 벽 너머로 우리가 만든 노래
내일 복도에서 인사나 해 볼까

307호, 308호

tracks.subject: waiting forty minutes at a subway exit for a second-hand marketplace seller who keeps texting 'almost there' about a rice cooker, both waiting at different exits
tracks.caption: Korean pluggnb in the soft melodic style. A glassy bell synth playing a looping major-seventh melody; a soft rounded 808 bass with short slides; bouncy drums with rimshots and offbeat claps, sparse hi-hats; a warm detuned pad underneath. Soft and floaty, low-passed highs, gentle tape saturation, dry vocal. Male light tenor, melodic half-sung rap with a sleepy, deadpan delivery, plain unprocessed voice. 146 BPM, B minor. Dreamy, deadpan and mildly salty. No autotune, no rage synths, no hard drill drums, no shouted ad-libs, no EDM drop.

tracks.title: Tekong Gemuk Kampung
tracks.mood: rowdy, cheeky, a whole kampung laughing
tracks.subject: the round, cheerful tekong of a kampung sepak takraw team who somehow serves them through to the district final while the whole village shouts from the drain edge
tracks.caption: Eastern-Indonesian party dance-rap in the 2025 TikTok 'Tabola Bale' style. Bouncy electronic party drums with a dotted, skipping kick and hand claps on two and four; a plucky synth bass bouncing on the off-beats; a bright marimba-style synth lead playing a short four-bar riff; a referee whistle and crowd shouts answering each line. Loud and dry mix, kick and claps forward, crowd shouts spread wide in a small hall. Male voice, a playful mid-register rapper-singer, half-rapping the verses and singing the chorus with a crowd shouting back. 124 BPM, G major. Rowdy, cheeky, a whole kampung laughing. No trap hi-hat rolls, no autotune, no dangdut suling, no EDM drop, no slow ballad section.

[Intro - party drums, synth bass and whistle]

Petang Ahad gelanggang tepi surau
Pak Mail tekong, perut dia bulat
Orang kampung lain gelak bila dia masuk
Tunggu dulu, tengok dia sepak

[Chorus]

Lawan pening, mak cik bersorak
Tekong gemuk juara kita

Esok pagi dia jual nasi lemak
Sama macam biasa

tracks.title: Milo Mesin Tingkat Tiga
tracks.subject: two night-shift nurses who meet at the third-floor vending machine every night at four for one shared can of Milo
tracks.caption: Acoustic folk-pop duet in the 2026 Indonesian-Malaysian singer-songwriter style. A fingerpicked nylon-string guitar playing a steady arpeggio; a brushed cajon keeping a soft backbeat; an upright bass walking gently under the chorus; a warm cello line entering in the choruses; a light glockenspiel touching the ends of phrases. Intimate and warm, close room sound, guitar in the centre, cello spread wide, very little reverb. Male and female voices, soft and close to the mic, trading lines like a conversation and singing the chorus in unison. 92 BPM, D major. Tired, tender and quietly certain. No trap beat, no autotune, no big drum kit, no rock guitar, no EDM pads.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - nylon guitar and glockenspiel]

[Verse 1]
Pukul empat pagi, wad dah senyap sikit
Kau tekan butang B7, aku bawa syiling
Mesin tu makan duit, kau ketuk dua kali
Tin Milo jatuh juga, kita gelak senyap-senyap

[Pre-Chorus]
Kau minum separuh, aku minum separuh

[Chorus]
Milo mesin tingkat tiga
Sejuk tangan, hati lega
Tak ada bunga, tak ada lilin
Cuma kau, aku, dan bunyi mesin

[Verse 2]
Kasut putih kau dah koyak tepi
Aku tulis nama kau atas tin, takut orang curi
Syif kita bertukar minggu depan, kau risau
Aku dah minta tukar, jangan bagi tahu sesiapa

[Pre-Chorus]
Kau minum separuh, aku minum separuh

[Chorus]
Milo mesin tingkat tiga
Sejuk tangan, hati lega
Minggu depan pun pukul empat
Aku tunggu kat mesin yang sama

[Outro - cello and guitar]
Ketuk dua kali
Nanti dia jatuh juga

tracks.title: Periuk Mak Jah
tracks.genre: 1950s Malay film-studio orchestral song (P. Ramlee lineage)
tracks.mood: sly, comic, polite on top and fed up underneath
tracks.subject: a man rehearsing, very politely, how to ask the neighbour to return the rice pot she borrowed three Hari Raya ago
tracks.caption: 1950s Malay film-studio orchestral song in the P. Ramlee and Shaw Brothers Jalan Ampas style. A swinging big-band horn section punching short stabs; a muted trumpet answering each vocal line; a violin section playing sweeping runs into the chorus; an upright bass walking; brushed swing drums with a light ride cymbal; a honky-tonk piano comping. Vintage studio sound leaning to mono, slight tape warmth, natural room reverb, bright horns. Male voice, a smooth baritone crooner with theatrical comic timing and short spoken asides. 132 BPM, B-flat major. Sly, comic, polite on top and fed up underneath. No modern drums, no synths, no autotune, no rock guitar, no hip-hop beat.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - big-band horns and violin run]

[Verse 1]
Selamat petang Mak Jah, cantik bunga kertas
Kucing awak gemuk, rumput pun dah potong
Oh ya, sebelum saya lupa, satu hal kecil
Periuk nasi saya, yang besar warna kelabu

[Pre-Chorus]
Pinjam masa Raya, tiga Raya tak balik-balik

[Chorus]
Periuk Mak Jah, periuk Mak Jah
Dulu periuk saya, sekarang periuk Mak Jah
Tiga kali Raya dah lalu depan pintu
Nasi saya masak dalam kuali, Mak Jah tahu?

[Verse 2]
Saya nampak dari pagar, ada atas dapur
Penuh gulai kawah, wangi sampai ke rumah saya
Mak Jah senyum lebar, hulur semangkuk gulai
Aduh, sedap betul, hilang pula ayat saya

[Pre-Chorus]
Esok saya cuba lagi, hari ini kenyang dulu

[Chorus]
Periuk Mak Jah, periuk Mak Jah
Dulu periuk saya, sekarang periuk Mak Jah
Kalau dia masak gulai sesedap ini
Biarlah periuk tu tinggal, saya datang tiap hari

[Outro - muted trumpet and horn stab]
Mak Jah, esok gulai apa?

tracks.title: Si Kelabu Lambat Lagi
tracks.genre: poetic piano chamber pop (Sal Priadi lane)
tracks.mood: wry, warm, a lump in the throat held back by a joke
tracks.subject: a retired postman who keeps racing pigeons on his flat's rooftop and waits every Sunday for the slowest bird, a grey one, long after the others are home
tracks.caption: Poetic piano chamber pop in the style of 2024-2026 Indonesian singer-songwriter Sal Priadi. An upright piano with soft felt playing slow broken chords; a string quartet breathing long notes behind the voice and rising in the chorus; a warm upright bass; a brushed snare entering in the second verse; a single clarinet line answering the vocal. Warm and close, felt piano in the centre, strings behind, a natural hall tail. Male voice, an intimate theatrical tenor, half-speaking the verses and opening up in the chorus. 84 BPM, E-flat major. Wry and warm, a lump in the throat held back by a joke. No trap beat, no autotune, no power-ballad drums, no electric guitar solo, no EDM pads.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - piano, solo cello]

[Verse 1]
Pukul empat semua dah balik
Yang putih, yang tompok, yang belang leher
Masuk sangkar, makan jagung, tidur awal
Tinggal satu tak sampai lagi

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku duduk atas tong air
Jam tangan lama, kopi dah sejuk

[Chorus]
Si Kelabu, lambat lagi
Singgah mana pula kali ini
Tak menang pun tak apa
Asalkan kau ingat jalan balik

[Verse 2]
Dulu aku hantar surat satu taman
Tak pernah sekali salah rumah
Kau ni pula, burung pos
Paling sesat dalam dunia

[Pre-Chorus]
Matahari dah jatuh atas kilang
Jiran panggil, Pak Din, masuklah

[Chorus]
Si Kelabu, lambat lagi
Tu dia, atas antena TV
Tak menang pun tak apa
Kau balik juga, macam aku dulu

[Outro - piano alone]
Ahad depan kita cuba lagi

tracks.title: Feri Akhir Ke Lumut
tracks.mood: patient, longing, rain on still water
tracks.subject: a woman waiting at the Lumut jetty in the rain for the last ferry from Pangkor carrying her husband home from his week at the fish-drying yard
tracks.caption: Irama asli, the slow traditional Malay asli rhythm song as sung in JKKN Bintang Asli competitions. A Malay violin playing ornamented slides and grace notes around the melody; an accordion holding sustained chords; rebana and gendang marking the slow asli rhythm cycle; a soft gong closing each cycle. Acoustic and roomy, violin and voice forward, gong low and soft, natural hall reverb. Female voice, mid register, with traditional Malay melismatic cengkok ornaments and unhurried phrasing. 66 BPM, A minor. Patient and longing, rain on still water. No drum kit, no synths, no autotune, no pop ballad piano, no dangdut beat.

tracks.title: 補衫 Póo Sann
tracks.subject: a woman who keeps bringing clothes to a market alteration stall because she has fallen for the quiet man at the sewing machine, and the day he stops charging her
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien song in French chanson musette waltz style, 3/4 time. Musette accordion with its bright wavering tremolo playing the melody between lines; nylon-string guitar strumming an oom-pah-pah waltz pattern; pizzicato upright bass on the downbeats; brushed snare whispering underneath. Small café-room recording, close and dry. A soft female alto, intimate and conversational, with light vibrato on held notes. 138 BPM in 3/4, D minor. Shy, warm and slowly smitten. No pop drums, no autotune, no synth pads, no rock guitar, no ballad power chorus.

我的外套 落一粒鈕仔

tracks.subject: a young restaurant cook at the dawn fish auction, bidding against a rival restaurant boss for the last big grouper on the floor
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien tango nuevo in the hard-accented Piazzolla style. Bandoneon playing sharp staccato chords and a crying lead; solo violin with chop strokes and glissando answers; marcato piano hammering the 3-3-2 rhythm; upright bass with arco slides and slapped accents. Dry chamber-room recording, hard attacks, nothing smoothed. A taut male tenor, clipped and breathless in the verses, full-voiced on the final chorus. 118 BPM, A minor. tracks.subject: the office junior who takes the bubble-tea order for the whole floor in the group chat and gets every sweetness level wrong
tracks.caption: Thai amapiano in the laid-back South African private-school style, sung in Thai. A sliding log-drum bass carrying the melody between kicks; tight shakers with an open hi-hat on the off-beat and a sparse rimshot pattern; warm Rhodes electric piano playing jazzy seventh chords; a plucked synth marimba riff answering the voice; a soft airy pad underneath. Warm and spacious mix, log drum up front, dry vocal with a short room reverb. Female mid-range voice, chatty and teasing in the verses, a group unison shout on the chorus. 112 BPM, F minor. Silly, bouncy and office-gossipy. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop, no four-on-the-floor house kick, no rap verse.

tracks.title: ชั่วโมงละสามร้อย (300 An Hour)
tracks.subject: two friends renting a rehearsal room by the hour in Saphan Khwai and racing the wall clock to finish one song before the owner knocks
tracks.caption: Thai garage alt-rock in a two-piece guitar-and-drums duo format. One fuzz-driven electric guitar split through two amps, chugging low riffs and high open-string stabs; a raw live drum kit with a pounding floor tom and crashing cymbals; a tambourine on the chorus; no bass guitar, the low end comes from the guitar. Raw rehearsal-room sound, roomy drums, saturated guitar, the vocal slightly overdriven. Female alto lead, deadpan in the verses and shouting on the chorus, a male drummer adding backing shouts. 148 BPM, E minor. Scrappy, loud and stubborn. No synths, no pop-punk polish, no autotune, no metal growls, no string section.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - fuzz guitar riff and floor tom]

[Verse 1]
ห้องสามชั้นสอง ตรงสะพานควาย
แอร์มีเสียงเหมือนคนไอทั้งคืน
เธอตีกลองด้วยไม้ที่หักไปข้างหนึ่ง
ฉันจูนกีตาร์ไปมองนาฬิกาไป

[Pre-Chorus]
เหลือสี่สิบนาที เพลงยังไม่มีท่อนฮุก

[Chorus]
ชั่วโมงละสามร้อย
หารสองคนละร้อยห้า
เล่นให้จบก่อนเจ้าของมาเคาะประตู
ชั่วโมงละสามร้อย เพลงนี้ต้องเสร็จวันนี้

[Verse 2]
เสียงข้างห้องเล่นเพลงร็อกยุคก่อน
เธอตะโกนว่าเราดังกว่าพวกนั้นแน่
สายสามขาดกลางเพลง ฉันเล่นต่อห้าสาย
เหงื่อหยดลงบนสมุดที่จดเนื้อ

[Pre-Chorus]
เหลือห้านาที ฮุกมันมาตอนนี้พอดี

[Chorus]
ชั่วโมงละสามร้อย
หารสองคนละร้อยห้า
เจ้าของเคาะประตู เราขอเล่นอีกรอบ
ชั่วโมงละสามร้อย เพลงนี้เสร็จแล้ววันนี้

[Outro - guitar feedback and last cymbal crash]
จ่ายคนละร้อยห้า กินข้าวมันไก่ข้างล่าง
อาทิตย์หน้ามาใหม่ จองไว้สองชั่วโมง

tracks.title: ตัวเงินตัวทอง (Lumpini Lizard)
tracks.subject: an office worker who eats lunch on the same Lumpini Park bench every day beside a monitor lizard he has named after his boss
tracks.caption: Thai psychedelic indie pop in the playful Bangkok-indie style. tracks.title: พริกเม็ดแรก (First Chili)
tracks.subject: a couple growing chilli and holy basil in paint buckets on their condo balcony and waking early to check whether the first chilli has turned red
tracks.caption: Thai acoustic indie folk with a gentle crooner feel. A fingerpicked nylon-string guitar playing a rolling pattern; a soft upright bass walking under the chorus; a light brushed snare; a melodica playing short answering phrases; a hand shaker keeping time. Intimate and dry, room tone audible, gentle tape warmth. Male baritone croon, warm and close-miked, unhurried, a soft female harmony joining on the last chorus. 92 BPM, D major. Tender, patient and quietly happy. No electric guitars, no programmed drums, no autotune, no big string swell, no pop-ballad key change.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - acoustic guitar fingerpicking, soft shaker]

[Verse 1]
ถังสีสองใบที่ระเบียงห้อง
เธอปลูกพริก ส่วนเราปลูกกะเพรา
ทุกเช้าเธอเดินไปทั้งที่ยังงัวเงีย
รดน้ำไป บ่นไป ว่ามันโตช้า

[Pre-Chorus]
เราชงกาแฟสองแก้ว
ยืนดูต้นไม้ด้วยกัน

[Chorus]
พริกเม็ดแรก ยังเขียวอยู่เลย
ไม่ต้องรีบหรอก ไม่เป็นไร
เราสองคนก็รอได้
เหมือนที่รอกันมาตั้งนาน

[Verse 2]
คืนฝนตกเธอลุกไปยกถังหนี
กลัวลมพัดล้ม เปียกทั้งตัว
เราหัวเราะ ยื่นผ้าขนหนูให้
แล้วนั่งดูฝนกันจนเช้า

[Pre-Chorus]
เช้าวันอาทิตย์เธอตะโกน
มาดูเร็ว มาดูนี่

[Chorus - with soft female harmony]
พริกเม็ดแรก มันแดงแล้วนะ
เด็ดมาใส่ผัดกะเพราจานเดียว
เผ็ดนิดเดียว แต่ยิ้มทั้งวัน
เพราะปลูกมันมากับเธอ

[Outro - guitar alone]
ฤดูหน้าปลูกมะนาวดีไหม

tracks.title: Ly Cà Phê Qua Mạn Ghe
tracks.genre: Mekong folktronica with hò Nam Bộ
tracks.subject: a girl selling iced coffee from a sampan at Cái Răng floating market who passes cups on a bamboo pole to a shy pineapple-boat man and charges him double until he says her name
tracks.caption: Mekong folktronica in the 2025 Phương Mỹ Chi folk-pop style, southern hò Nam Bộ melody over electronic dance production. A đàn kìm moon lute playing bouncy pentatonic riffs; a đàn bầu bending long slides between phrases; a programmed four-on-the-floor kick with a shaker on the off-beats; a round sub-bass; a plucked synth arpeggio under the chorus. Clean and airy, folk instruments forward, electronics tight and dry, wide reverb only on the hò calls. Female voice, a bright young folk soprano with southern hò ornaments, long open calls and playful spoken asides. 118 BPM, D major. Cheeky, sunny and teasing. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop, no rap verse, no Western rock guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - đàn kìm riff and hò call]
Hò ơ... ghe ai bán khóm đậu sát ghe em

[Verse 1]
Năm giờ sáng chợ nổi Cái Răng
Em đá ly cà phê, sữa đặc khuấy nhanh
Ghe khóm anh lần nào cũng ghé
Mà hỏi tên em thì anh lại làm thinh

[Pre-Chorus]
Cây sào em đưa, cái ly qua mạn
Tiền anh đưa lại, ướt hết bàn tay

[Chorus]
Ly cà phê qua mạn ghe, hai chục ngàn nghen anh
Người ta mười ngàn mà anh thì hai chục
Bao giờ anh gọi được tên em
Thì em tính giá như người quen

[Verse 2]
Anh treo trái khóm trên đầu sào
Gửi qua cho em, gọt sẵn hẳn hoi
Mấy bà bán bông cười nghiêng ghe
Nói thằng nhỏ đó thương con Út rồi

[Pre-Chorus]
Cây sào em đưa, nước sông lên xuống
Anh mở miệng ra rồi lại cúi đầu

[Chorus]
Ly cà phê qua mạn ghe, hôm nay ba chục nghen anh
Còn im nữa là em lên năm chục
Út Hạnh đó, nói đi, có khó gì
Kêu một tiếng là em bán không lời

[Outro - đàn bầu slide and kick fade]
Hò ơ... Út Hạnh đây, mai anh ghé nữa nghen
Mười ngàn thôi, em tặng thêm nụ cười

tracks.title: Chấm Xanh Trên Bản Đồ
tracks.subject: a man who stays up every night watching his girlfriend's ride-hailing driver dot crawl across the Saigon map until it parks outside their building, then goes down with a warm bowl of noodles
tracks.caption: V-pop R&B dance-pop in the 2025 Dương Domic chart style. A tight drum machine with a snappy clap on two and four; warm Rhodes electric piano chords; muted funk guitar plucks on the off-beats; a round synth bass sliding between roots; a soft string pad opening the chorus. Glossy but intimate, punchy low end, dry lead vocal with a short slap delay. Male voice, a smooth light tenor sung close to the mic in the verses, lifting into falsetto with stacked harmonies in the chorus. 104 BPM, Bb major. Warm, smitten and gently giddy. No trap hi-hats, no heavy autotune, no EDM drop, no rap verse, no ballad piano intro.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes chords and clap]

[Verse 1]
Mười một giờ đêm em nhắn: chuyến cuối nha anh
Khách đi Thủ Đức, xa xíu mà thôi
Anh mở app lên, ngồi canh một chấm xanh
Bò qua cầu Sài Gòn chậm như con kiến

[Pre-Chorus]
Đèn đỏ thì em dừng, anh cũng nín thở
Rẽ trái một cái, anh đứng dậy luôn

[Chorus]
Chấm xanh trên bản đồ, chạy về đây với anh
Nồi mì anh nấu rồi, trứng còn lòng đào
Đừng ghé đâu nữa, em ơi
Đậu dưới nhà, anh xuống liền

[Verse 2]
Em nói anh khùng, canh hoài không biết chán
Ngày mai anh đi làm sớm thì sao
Cả thành phố cả triệu chấm giống nhau
Anh chỉ thuộc lòng đường về của một người

[Pre-Chorus]
Em gửi tin nhắn: còn năm phút nữa
Anh hâm nồi mì thêm một lần thôi

[Chorus]
Chấm xanh trên bản đồ, quẹo vô hẻm nhà mình
Áo khoác em ướt sương, nón còn chưa tháo
Đưa anh chìa khóa xe, em ơi
Lên nhà ăn mì, để anh khóa cổng

[Outro - falsetto over strings]
Chấm xanh ơi, ngủ ngon
Mai em chạy, anh lại thức canh

tracks.title: Kêu Lô Tô Đêm Ba Mươi
tracks.subject: a shy delivery boy drafted to call the numbers at his alley's Tết lô tô night, who starts rhyming the numbers and wins over the whole street
tracks.caption: 1980s Euro-disco in the Modern Talking style that Vietnamese families still play at Tết parties, revived with a 2026 nostalgic shine. An octave-pumping synth bass on straight eighths; a LinnDrum-style four-on-the-floor with a gated snare; bright brass-synth stabs answering each vocal line; a chiming DX-style electric piano; a high falsetto backing choir echoing the chorus hook. Shiny 1985 studio sound, wide stereo synths, big gated reverb on the snare. Male voice, a deadpan mid baritone telling the story in the verses, singing the chorus full-throated with the falsetto choir answering. 124 BPM, E minor. Silly, bouncy and triumphant. No trap, no autotune, no modern EDM drop, no Vinahouse bass, no rap.

Shiny 1985 studio sound, wide stereo synths, big gated reverb on the snare. Male voice, a deadpan mid baritone telling the story in the verses, singing the chorus full-throated with the falsetto choir answering. 124 BPM, E minor. Silly, bouncy and triumphant. No trap, no autotune, no modern EDM drop, no Vinahouse bass, no rap.

tracks.title: Cuộn Băng Trong Máy Akai
tracks.subject: a young man repairing a 1970s Akai reel-to-reel deck in a Chợ Lớn alley shop who finds a half-finished tape of a stranger's love song inside and spends a week trying to find the singer
tracks.caption: Saigon psychedelic soul revival in the style of Saigon Soul Revival, rooted in the city's late-1960s nhạc trẻ sound. A fuzz-toned electric guitar drenched in spring reverb; a Farfisa-style combo organ holding swirling chords; a melodic Fender bass walking under the verses; dry live drums with a tambourine on the backbeat; a sáo trúc bamboo flute answering the vocal lines. Warm analog tape saturation, narrow 1970s stereo, room ambience on the drums. Female voice, a warm, slightly husky alto, unhurried and conversational, with a light harmony on the chorus. 92 BPM, A minor. Hazy, curious and quietly romantic. No modern pop production, no autotune, no trap drums, no synth pads, no jazz big band.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - fuzz guitar and organ swell]

[Verse 1]
Tiệm sửa đồ điện trong hẻm Chợ Lớn
Anh mở bụng máy Akai cũ của ai
Cuộn băng còn kẹt, quấn được nửa chừng
Bấm nút một cái, có giọng con gái hát

[Pre-Chorus]
Hát tới câu thứ ba thì dừng
Tiếng cười, rồi tiếng ai kêu tắt máy đi

[Chorus]
Cuộn băng trong máy Akai, em là ai
Hát dở một bài tình ca không tên
Anh tua đi tua lại cả tuần
Thuộc giọng em trước khi biết mặt em

[Verse 2]
Ông ve chai nói lượm được ở Phú Nhuận
Nhà có giàn bông giấy, cổng màu xanh
Anh chạy xe dò từng con hẻm nhỏ
Cuộn băng trong túi, tay cầm ổ bánh mì

[Pre-Chorus]
Cổng xanh mở, một cô gái ra phơi đồ
Ngân nga đúng câu thứ ba

[Chorus]
Cuộn băng trong máy Akai, là em đó
Mười năm trước hát chơi với anh trai
Em cười: bài đó em chưa viết xong
Vậy hát tiếp đi, anh thu lại cho

[Outro - flute and organ fade]
Máy Akai quay đều
Câu thứ tư, mình viết chung

tracks.title: Giàn Giáo Tre
tracks.subject: a bamboo-scaffolding builder lashing poles seven floors up on a narrow Hanoi Old Quarter tube house while a storm wind comes in off the Red River
tracks.caption: Folk-rap heroic ballad in the 2025 style of Đức Phúc's Intervision-winning Phù Đổng Thiên Vương, northern Vietnamese folk melody with a modern rap verse. A sáo trúc bamboo flute carrying the main melody; đàn tranh zither glissandos between phrases; deep taiko-style floor drums building under each chorus; a sustained cello section; sparse piano octaves. Cinematic but clean, big drum room, wide strings, flute and voice centred and dry. Male strong tenor lead climbing to a chest-voice climax, plus a male baritone rap verse, half-spoken and rhythmic over the drums. 84 BPM, C minor. Steady, proud and wind-swept. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop, no electric guitar solo, no choir.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - sáo trúc solo and đàn tranh]

[Verse 1]
Bảy tầng nhà ống trên phố Hàng Bạc
Tôi buộc từng cây tre bằng dây thép mềm
Gió sông Hồng lên, trời đen một góc
Giàn rung dưới chân như sợi đàn căng

[Pre-Chorus]
Người dưới đường ngước lên, che mắt
Tôi buộc thêm nút, chưa vội xuống đâu

[Chorus]
Giàn giáo tre ơi, cong mà không gãy
Gió quật bao nhiêu, mình cứ đứng đây
Một nút dây chặt, thêm một nút nữa
Chiều nay xong tầng bảy, tối về ăn cơm

[Verse 2 - rap]
Ba tôi dạy, nút buộc phải xoắn ba vòng
Tre già thì dẻo, tre non thì hay rung
Mưa tạt ngang mặt, mũ bảo hộ kêu lộp bộp
Thằng Tùng dưới kia la: anh ơi xuống đi
Tôi la lại: đưa thêm cây, buộc nốt góc này
Nhà người ta mai đổ mái, không chờ được ai

[Chorus]
Giàn giáo tre ơi, cong mà không gãy
Mưa tạnh rồi kìa, phố cũ sáng đèn
Đứng trên tầng bảy nhìn mái ngói đỏ
Tôi buộc nút cuối, rồi mới xuống đường

[Outro - flute and floor drum]
Giàn giáo tre đứng
Qua thêm một cơn giông

tracks.mood: frantic, cheeky and laughing at itself
tracks.subject: a rookie paddler on a Tuen Ng dragon boat crew at Stanley who keeps losing the drummer's beat and splashing the whole boat
tracks.caption: Cantonese hard-dance pop with a hardstyle edge. tracks.title: 六點交更
tracks.mood: sleepy, warm and quietly in love
tracks.subject: a nurse coming off night shift and her boyfriend leaving for his morning job sharing a twenty-minute breakfast at six a.m., the only time their days overlap
tracks.caption: Cantonese techno-pop built on a Berlin-style warehouse groove. A steady four-on-the-floor analog kick, a rolling acid bassline kept low and round, filtered minor chord stabs opening slowly through each section, ticking closed hi-hats and a soft analog pad under the chorus. Dark-to-dawn mix with long filter sweeps and warm tape low end. A soft male baritone close to the mic, half-spoken in the verses and gently sung on the hook. 124 BPM, A minor. tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
五點五十 我煲咗水
兩隻蛋 啱啱熟
你開門 仲著住對白鞋
話病房 今晚好靜

[Pre-Chorus]
你除咗口罩 揉吓眼
我將個多士 切開一半

[Chorus]
六點交更 我哋得廿分鐘
你講你嘅夜 我講我嘅朝
你一邊食 一邊瞌眼
我唔趕 我陪你坐埋呢陣

[Verse]
十八號床 個阿婆
半夜叫你 陪佢傾偈
我話佢 一定好鍾意你
你話佢 叫咗你三次阿女

[Pre-Chorus]
窗外天光 照住你頭髮
我執好袋 鎖匙放低

[Chorus]
六點交更 我哋得廿分鐘
你講你嘅夜 我講我嘅朝
你攬住個枕頭 已經瞓著
我幫你冚好張被 先至出門口

[Bridge]
星期六 我哋都放假
我會瞓到 你醒為止

[Chorus]
六點交更 我哋得廿分鐘
夠我知道 你今晚點過
門口張紙仔 寫住煲入面有粥
你醒返嚟 就知道我諗住你

[Outro]
聽朝六點 我再煲水

tracks.title: 外澳下雨天
tracks.subject: the only surfboard-rental guy open at Wai'ao beach on a rainy weekday teaching an accountant to stand up on a board
tracks.caption: Mandarin surf rock in the 1960s instrumental-surf style with a garage edge. Reverb-drenched Fender lead guitar playing twangy low-string melodies; tremolo-picked rhythm guitar; a Farfisa organ holding bright chords; round electric bass walking fast; splashy surf drums with constant snare rolls. Spring reverb on everything, live garage room, amps slightly overdriven. Male voice, deadpan baritone-tenor talking through the verses, shouted gang vocals on the chorus. 168 BPM, E minor. Sunburnt, goofy and stubborn. No trap drums, no autotune, no EDM synths, no ballad slowdown, no modern pop-punk polish.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - twang guitar and surf drum roll]

[Verse 1]
禮拜三下雨，整條海灘只剩我開店
你穿著襯衫走過來，問板子一小時多少錢
你說你是會計，今天請了特休假
算了三年別人的帳，想算一下自己的浪

[Pre-Chorus]
趴下去，划三下，聽我喊

[Chorus]
站起來，站起來，外澳下雨天
雨打在臉上，跟海水一樣鹹
跌倒了也沒差，反正都已經濕
站起來，再一次，第十七次

[Verse 2]
你喝了半個太平洋，眼鏡沉在海底
我說沒關係，龜山島也看不清
到了第四十分鐘，你站了兩秒鐘
叫得比颱風還大聲，嚇跑一整排海鷗

[Pre-Chorus]
趴下去，划三下，看前面

[Chorus]
站起來，站起來，外澳下雨天
雨打在臉上，跟海水一樣鹹
兩秒鐘也算數，記在你帳本上
站起來，下禮拜三，我還在這邊

[Outro - organ and twang fade]
板子算你便宜，雨天打八折
會計先生，記得幫我報稅

tracks.title: 多坐兩站
tracks.subject: riding the late bus with his girlfriend asleep on his shoulder and staying on two stops past home so she won't wake
tracks.caption: Mandarin liquid drum and bass in the smooth London liquid-funk style. Rolling chopped breakbeat with crisp ghost snares; a deep round sub bass moving in half-time; Rhodes electric piano playing jazzy seventh chords; a warm analog pad swelling under the chorus; a soft clean electric guitar plucking short phrases. Smooth late-night mix, wide pads, crisp breaks and subby low end. Female voice, a soft close-miked alto singing conversationally, light double-track on the chorus. 172 BPM, D major. Warm, hushed and quietly giddy. No dubstep wobble, no neurofunk growl bass, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no big-room EDM drop.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes chords and filtered breakbeat]

[Verse 1]
末班公車開過基隆路
你靠著我說只睡一下下
口罩歪一邊，耳機掉一隻
你的頭髮有我們剛剛那碗麵的味道

[Pre-Chorus]
廣播說下一站，是我們家

[Chorus]
我沒按鈴，我多坐兩站
肩膀麻了也不想換
窗外的燈一格一格倒退
讓我再多愛你兩站

[Verse 2]
司機從鏡子裡看我一眼
我比了一個噓，他把車開得好慢
你在夢裡笑，說了一句聽不懂的話
我猜那是在叫我名字

[Pre-Chorus]
廣播說終點站，請全部下車

[Chorus]
我沒按鈴，我多坐兩站
走回去要二十分鐘
你醒來問這是哪裡
我說剛好，剛好陪你走回家

[Outro - pad and sub bass fade]
下次你再睡著
我們坐到底

tracks.title: 魟魚第七圈
tracks.subject: a man spending a whole rainy afternoon on the bench in an aquarium's underwater tunnel, counting the laps of one manta ray over his head
tracks.caption: Mandarin shoegaze in the early-1990s glide-guitar style. Layered fuzz guitars with reverse reverb forming a wall; a lead guitar bending notes with the tremolo arm; a melodic bass carrying the tune under the noise; steady mid-tempo drums with washy cymbals; a faint organ drone. Dense wall of sound, vocals sunk under the guitars, smeared cymbals, warm tape hiss. Soft male tenor, breathy and half-whispered, buried in the mix. 92 BPM, A major. Drowsy, blurred and oddly comforted. No bright pop production, no autotune, no trap or EDM drums, no guitar solo shredding, no clean acoustic strumming.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - feedback guitars and slow drums]

[Verse 1]
下雨的禮拜二 水族館沒什麼人
我坐在隧道中間 那張藍色的長凳
頭上那隻魟魚 慢慢地游過來
肚子白白的 好像在對我笑

[Pre-Chorus]
小朋友走了 導覽也走了
只剩我 跟玻璃後面的牠

[Chorus]
第七圈 牠又經過我
不趕時間 也不說什麼
外面的雨 跟我無關
第七圈 我也不想走

[Verse 2]
手機沒電了 也沒人在找我
上班的事 暫時放在門口
牠翻了個身 影子蓋住我的臉
整條隧道 安靜得像水底

[Pre-Chorus]
廣播說 再半小時要關門了
我說好 再等牠一圈

[Chorus]
第八圈 牠又經過我
不趕時間 也不說什麼
明天的雨 我再來看
第八圈 我才捨得走

[Outro - guitars dissolving into drone]
藍藍的 慢慢的

頭上那隻魟魚 慢慢地游過來
肚子白白的 好像在對我笑
[Pre-Chorus]
小朋友走了 導覽也走了
只剩我 跟玻璃後面的牠
[Chorus]
第七圈 牠又經過我
不趕時間 也不說什麼
外面的雨 跟我無關
第七圈 我也不想走
[Verse 2]
手機沒電了 也沒人在找我
上班的事 暫時放在門口
牠翻了個身 影子蓋住我的臉
整條隧道 安靜得像水底
[Pre-Chorus]
廣播說 再半小時要關門了
我說好 再等牠一圈
[Chorus]
第八圈 牠又經過我
不趕時間 也不說什麼
明天的雨 我再來看
第八圈 我才捨得走
[Outro - guitars dissolving into drone]
藍藍的 慢慢的

tracks.title: 早上七點羽球場
tracks.subject: two retired couples playing their weekly grudge doubles badminton match at seven a.m. in the community sports centre, with a bottle of soy milk as the prize
tracks.caption: Mandarin funk band pop in the live 1970s horn-band style. Tight live drums on a sixteenth-note hi-hat groove; slap-and-pop electric bass; chicken-scratch rhythm guitar; a trumpet, tenor sax and trombone section hitting sharp stabs and short unison riffs; a Hammond organ with percussive clicks. Dry tight band room, punchy bass and kick, bright horns. Male tenor, punchy and comic, trading call-and-response lines with group backing vocals. 108 BPM, E minor. Sweaty, cheeky and bouncy. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop, no synth bass, no disco strings.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - funk guitar and horn stabs]

[Verse 1]
早上七點 活動中心 地板還涼涼的
王伯伯 綁好護膝 說今天要報仇
王媽媽 揮兩下拍 先把汗擦一擦
我老婆 拉拉筋 說我們上禮拜輸好慘

[Pre-Chorus]
一瓶豆漿 押在網子下
誰輸誰請 不准賴帳

[Chorus]
殺球 殺球 老骨頭也會跳
救球 救球 膝蓋先別叫
比分十九比二十 心臟快跳掉
早上七點 我們最會鬧

[Verse 2]
王伯伯 一個假動作 球輕輕放網前
我衝上去 球鞋飛掉 全場笑到彎腰
王媽媽 說不算不算 我說怎麼不算
裁判是管理員阿姨 她說先去撿鞋

[Pre-Chorus]
一瓶豆漿 還在網子下
最後一球 大家都不講話

[Chorus]
殺球 殺球 老骨頭也會跳
救球 救球 膝蓋先別叫
二十二比二十 豆漿我來倒
下禮拜七點 換你們來鬧

[Outro - horn tag]
下禮拜 再來

tracks.title: 襪子三雙一百
tracks.subject: a night-market sock seller doing a fast patter routine to sell three pairs for a hundred dollars
tracks.caption: Mandarin big-band swing pop in the 1940s jump-swing style. Full trumpet, trombone and saxophone sections trading shout riffs; a walking upright bass; swung ride-cymbal drums with rimshot accents; a stride piano comping; a muted trumpet answering the vocal. Roomy vintage big-band hall, brass bright and forward, light room reverb. Male baritone in fast hawker patter on the verses, crooning smoothly on the chorus. 152 BPM, B-flat major. Brassy, cheeky and fast-talking. No electro-swing beats, no trap drums, no autotune, no EDM synths, no ballad tempo.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - brass shout and drum fill]

[Verse 1]
來喔來喔，走過路過不要錯過
純棉的襪子，穿了腳不臭
黑的白的灰的，還有一雙印恐龍
阿姨你摸摸看，這個彈性像彈簧

[Pre-Chorus]
不是一雙一百，也不是兩雙一百

[Chorus]
三雙一百，三雙一百
穿去上班，穿去約會
破了一個洞，算我的
三雙一百，今天最後一攤

[Verse 2]
年輕人你別走，你的襪子在笑你
大拇指都跑出來，跟我打招呼
買給你爸，買給你男朋友
買了不後悔，後悔我請你吃雞排

[Pre-Chorus]
不要殺價喔，我已經流血了

[Chorus]
三雙一百，三雙一百
穿去上班，穿去約會
快收攤了，算你四雙
四雙一百，只有今天這攤

[Outro - brass tag]
好啦好啦，五雙
不要跟別人說
